+from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+
+class TestEmptyPathInPrefixlessRouter:
+    def test_http_get_empty_path(self):
+        router = APIRouter()
+
+        @router.get("")
+        def read_root():
+            return {"message": "Hello World"}
+
+        app = FastAPI()
+        app.include_router(router)
+
+        client = TestClient(app)
+        response = client.get("/")
+        assert response.status_code == 200
+        assert response.json() == {"message": "Hello World"}
+
+        # The generated route path should be normalized to "/"
+        assert router.routes[0].path == "/"
+
+    def test_websocket_empty_path(self):
+        router = APIRouter()
+
+        @router.websocket("")
+        async def websocket_endpoint(websocket):
+            await websocket.accept()
+            await websocket.send_text("Hello WebSocket")
+            await websocket.close()
+
+        app = FastAPI()
+        app.include_router(router)
+
+        client = TestClient(app)
+        with client.websocket_connect("/") as websocket:
+            data = websocket.receive_text()
+            assert data == "Hello WebSocket"
+
+        # The generated route path should be normalized to "/"
+        assert router.routes[0].path == "/"
